title: Nera Quill
subtitle: NPC · Supporting NPC · debt collector turned witness

fields.label: Aspects
fields.value: Collector Who Won't Collect a Lie; My Badge Is Also My Leash; Ira Still Owes Me a Favor.

fields.label: First impression
fields.value: A spotless red coat with one black mourning button. Lets a question hang before answering the question beneath it.

fields.label: Want / obstacle
fields.value: Get the forged names struck from the roll. Her original warrant also implicates her in delivering earlier false collections.

fields.label: Offer / boundary
fields.value: Offers a duplicate roll and access to the auction gallery. Will not surrender another collector as a scapegoat to save herself.

fields.label: GM knowledge
fields.value: Commissioner Vale countersigned the duplicate after the Office of Civic Time closed. Nera kept the receipt in her mourning button.

fields.label: Mechanics
fields.value: Rapport +3, Contacts +2, Will +1; unlisted +0. Physical [1][2]; mental [1][2][3], one box per hit. Empty mild consequence 2. Stunt proposal, Familiar Faces: +2 Contacts to overcome when locating an off-duty municipal collector in Bellwether.

fields.label: Pressure / exit
fields.value: If threatened, she seeks public witnesses rather than a fight. She will testify under protection even if doing so costs her badge.
